source: spec 048 (services/backend-core/specs/048-offer-engine-v1/spec.md) §6, §6.1 and §9; Jira RT-1335 (RT-286 slice S5 seed)
notes: Offer type buy_x_get_y_percent with rewardSelection cheapest (OD-2): eligible units are sorted by unit price, highest first, ties broken by cart line order (earlier line first) and then product id; the last k x Y units are the rewards, k = floor(n / (X + Y)), capped at maxApplicationsPerSale.
A cart line is eligible when its product is in the offer's materialised eligible set (OD-6). A line with a manual discount (OD-5) or a non-whole quantity (F-9) never takes part.
Discount of a reward unit = percentOff% of its unit price, rounded half up once at the currency minor unit (OD-28-3).

expected.lines are the capture lines after the OD-4 split: each reward unit on its own quantity-1 line after the rest of its source line. promotionDiscount is the CaptureSaleLine.promotion.discountAmount, or null when the line carries no promotion (no application, or not eligible). lineAmount is the line's net.

Returns (spec 048 §9, multi-return form), per offer O: D_held = the discountAmount of the O units not returned before this return, less the clawbacks of O already recorded on earlier returns of the sale; disc_ret = min(discountAmount of the O units returned now, D_held); D_remaining = the evaluation of the O-eligible units still kept after this return; refund = gross returned - max(disc_ret, D_held - D_remaining); clawback = max(0, D_held - D_remaining - disc_ret). For a first return D_held = D_orig and refund = min(net returned, gross returned - (D_orig - D_remaining)). outcome is accepted, promotion_clawback_exceeds_refund (refund < 0, OD-10; clawback is then null) or promotion_return_requires_clawback (clawback > 0 while OD-11 is open, RT-1340).

returnSequences apply their steps in order to one sale; each step's expected assumes every earlier step was recorded with its clawback (a step refused only by the OD-11 interim rule is counted as recorded, the behaviour once OD-11 is decided).

evaluate.description: Spec 048 §6.1 E2 (OD-2): the cheapest units of the whole basket take the reward, 60 and 40, not 80 and 40.
Spec 048 §6.1 E4 (OD-4): one line A 150.00 x 2; the reward unit is split onto its own quantity-1 line.
Spec 048 §6.1 E6: 33.33 x 40% = 13.332, rounded half up once at the minor unit to 13.33.
Spec 048 §6.1 E7 (OD-5): the 100 line carries a manual 10% discount, so it never takes part; one eligible unit, no application.
Spec 048 §6.1 E8 (OD-1): E3 where the 40 is an excluded product (not in the eligible set).
Equal prices: ties break by cart line order (earlier line first), then product id, so the later cart line (L2) takes the reward even though its product id sorts first.
Buy 2 get 1 at 50%: six units, two applications; the two cheapest units (10 and 5) are rewards.
Half up at the minor unit: 10.10 x 5% = 0.505 rounds to 0.51.
maxApplicationsPerSale = 1 on one line of four units: one reward unit is split off.
A measured line (quantity 1.500; capture accepts fractional quantities only once spec 046 lands) never takes part (F-9): one eligible unit, no application.
A quantity written with zero decimals (2.000000) is whole and takes part.
Buy 1 get 2 free (Y > X, P = 100): the two cheapest of three units are free.
JPY (minor unit 0): 999 x 25% = 249.75 rounds half up to 250.
OMR (minor unit 3): 1.235 x 50% = 0.6175 rounds half up to 0.618.

returns.description: Spec 048 §9 table row 1: E3, return the 40 (the reward). The 60 would be the reward now, so D_remaining = 24; refund min(24, 40 - (16 - 24)) = 24.00. No clawback.
Spec 048 §9 table row 2: E3, return the 100 (the trigger). 60 + 40 still qualify; refund min(100, 100 - 0) = 100.00.
Spec 048 §9 table row 3: E1, return the 300. D_remaining = 0; refund min(300, 300 - 80) = 220.00. Clawback 80.00, so refused while OD-11 is open (RT-1340).
E2, return the 100. 80, 60, 40 kept: the 40 is the reward now (16); refund min(100, 100 - (40 - 16)) = 76.00. Clawback 24.00, refused while OD-11 is open.
E3, full return of every unit: refund min(184, 200 - 16) = 184.00, the amount paid. No clawback.
OD-10: X7 (buy 1 get 2 free), return only the 50 (the trigger). refund min(50, 50 - (70 - 0)) = -20.00 < 0: refused; the till asks to add the reward units.
X7, full return of all three units: refund min(50, 120 - 70) = 50.00, the amount paid.
X4, return the split-off reward unit (net 60). Three units kept still earn the one application (max 1): refund min(60, 100 - 0) = 60.00.
X4, return one unit of the quantity-3 line. Three units kept still earn the one application: refund 100.00.

returnSequences.description: X7 (buy 1 get 2 free, 50 paid for 50, 40, 30). Return 1: the 40 and the 30 (the rewards): D_held 70, disc_ret 70, nothing kept earns a discount; refund 70 - max(70, 70 - 0) = 0.00. Return 2: the 50: D_held 0 (no discount left on unreturned units, no clawback yet); refund 50 - max(0, 0) = 50.00, not refused. Total refunded 50.00 = paid.

E2 (100, 80, 60 -24, 40 -16; 240 paid). Return 1: the 40: D_held 40, disc_ret 16, kept 100, 80, 60 earn 24; refund 40 - max(16, 16) = 24.00. Return 2: the 60: D_held 24, disc_ret 24, kept 100, 80 earn 32; refund 60 - max(24, -8) = 36.00. Return 3: the 100: D_held 0; refund 100.00. No clawback anywhere; the customer keeps the 80 for 80.00.

E1 (300, 200 -80; 420 paid). Return 1: the 300: D_held 80, disc_ret 0, nothing kept earns a discount; refund 300 - max(0, 80) = 220.00, clawback 80.00 (refused while OD-11 is open; the later step assumes it was recorded, as after OD-11 is decided). Return 2: the 200: D_held 80 - 80 = 0, disc_ret min(80, 0) = 0; refund 200 - max(0, 0) = 200.00. Total refunded 420.00 = paid.
